instruction: Candid photographic medium close-up of an indoor festive venue with warm hanging lights and floral decorations. The woman in the black and white floral dress (R1) is on the right, facing left in profile, smiling warmly as she wraps her arms around her partner's neck. She is embraced by a man with black dreadlocks in a dark blue suit, who looks up at her with a smile. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm overhead light bulbs, creating a cozy atmosphere with a shallow depth of field blurring the colorful background.
